description: This file defines the 'Header' utility class in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, which provides methods for parsing, normalizing, and splitting HTTP headers according to the PSR-7 specifications.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for processing HTTP headers within the GuzzleHttp PSR-7 implementation.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses header values containing ';' separated parameters into an array of associative arrays, ensuring key-value pairs are correctly extracted and handling parameters without explicit values.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Deprecated method that splits header values by commas into a flat array of header strings.

methods.name: splitList
methods.description: Splits a string or array of header values into individual comma-separated tokens, respecting quoted sections to avoid splitting within quotes.
